pitfalls: (1) After fixing 16 stale assertions, 7 'parallel-only race' smokes emerged that pass in single-process but TIMEOUT under worker-pool load. Solution: per-smoke timeoutMs bumps. (2) c8 v11 crashes with 'JavaScript heap out of memory' during the JSON merge phase when 162 children's V8 coverage data is aggregated; fix is NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 prepended to test:coverage script. (3) story-owner-lease used  to scan git porcelain, which matched ANY owner-lease.json in the worktree (including tracked-but-modified ones from the worktree's own metadata); narrowed to the SPECIFIC probe path B-c55d/owner-lease.json. (4) CHK-002:adversarial:0 over-reach guard expected only lattice-baseline manifest changes; reality required 8 entries. Evidence is verdict=waived with scope-ack documentation. (5) Always run npm install to materialize devDependencies — c8 was in B-c6cf's devDeps but never installed on main's node_modules until this story ran npm install.
